blog-game-jam-meta-description: Portfolio entry: Developing an AI companion for a game, built in 72 hours at Wowie Jam 4.0 with Godot.
blog-game-jam-heading: Wowie Jam 4.0: An AI Companion in 72 Hours
gamejam-section-intro-text: Took part in the Wowie Jam 4.0 under the theme 'Collaborate With AI'. The goal was a game in just 72 hours, where collaboration with artificial intelligence is the core gameplay element. It was my first game jam, and it combined creative and technical challenges.
gamejam-section-team-text: A team of two programmers, a musician, and an artist built a playable, atmospheric demo in three days. I was one of the two programmers and wrote the AI companion.
gamejam-section-theme-text: In “Jack and Markus”, a young boy gets lost in a mysterious forest. A forest creature accompanies him and helps him find his way to freedom. Depending on the player's choices, it evolves individually, as a melee or ranged fighter. This companion forms the central AI core of the game.
gamejam-section-tech-text: The game was built in the Godot Engine, with the main logic in GDScript, complemented by C# components for the AI. I implemented the companion as a state-based system: its behavior and development adapt dynamically to how the player acts, for example to distance, threats, and direct actions.
gamejam-section-challenges-text: The biggest challenge was team coordination under high time pressure. The level design had to be understandable without long explanations, and level, gameplay, UI, and atmosphere all had to work at the same time. Quick decisions and pragmatic solutions were decisive.
gamejam-section-outro-text: The game jam was intense and educational. In three days we produced a playable demo, and I learned to implement an AI companion's behavior quickly and to coordinate within a team under time pressure. I will carry the experience in agile development, team organization, and fast decision-making into future projects.
